## Project Overview
Chhath Radio — a full-stack web radio app for Chhath Puja festival music. FastAPI backend + Next.js frontend, with Docker Compose deployment. Features: live radio streaming, song queue, Chhath facts, festival countdown, ghat ambience sounds, listener presence, admin panel.

## Completed Work
- Fixed Hindi font weight in ChhathCountdown
- Fixed ProgressBar seek-while-paused (resume from seeked position)
- Added P key to open/close playlist
- Fixed full footer in PageClient (social icons, donate, छठ के गीत text, peivee→LinkedIn)
- Added GhatAmbience to PageClient UI (visible button)
- Added ChhathFacts to PageClient (10s rotation with fade)
- Fixed Chhath date calculation — removed ephem, use localStorage cache + local JS fallback
- Removed ephem from backend requirements
- Rebuilt frontend Docker container with Web Audio API GhatAmbience + CSP media-src fix
- Verified Ghat sound works after container restart
- Replaced all amber/yellow color tokens with orange equivalents across RadioPlayer.tsx and other components (LiveClock, ChhathFacts, JalArghya, UpNext, ListenerCount, GeometricBg, NowPlaying, Controls)
- Investigated radio API endpoints; confirmed available routes
- Fetched `/api/radio/queue` — returns 100 songs with YouTube video IDs and URLs
- Read RadioPlayer.tsx lines 1-80: confirmed it imports `YouTubeIFramePlayerAdapter` from `@/lib/youtube-adapter` and `useRadioStore` from `@/lib/radio-store`; uses vinyl album art component with spin animation

## Key Technical Decisions
- Backend uses FastAPI with PostgreSQL + Redis; no ephem dependency
- Chhath dates computed via local JS fallback + localStorage cache (no backend ephem)
- GhatAmbience uses Web Audio API (not HTML audio elements) to avoid CSP issues
- CSP media-src updated to allow audio sources
- Color theme: orange (#f97316, #ea580c, #fb923c) replacing amber/yellow (#f5c842, #e8860a, #ffd700)
- Frontend Docker container rebuilt after CSP/audio changes
- Radio queue is YouTube-based: songs have `youtube_video_id` and `youtube_url` fields — no direct audio stream URL
- `/api/radio/stream-url` does NOT exist; stream is YouTube-based
- RadioPlayer uses `YouTubeIFramePlayerAdapter` (from `@/lib/youtube-adapter`) for playback

## Relevant Files & Code
- `backend/app/api/radio.py` — radio API; available endpoints: `/api/radio/queue`
- `backend/app/api/songs.py` — songs API; `/api/songs`
- `backend/seed_songs.py` — song seeding script (HTML entities fixed)
- `frontend/components/radio/RadioPlayer.tsx` — main player, orange theme applied; imports YouTubeIFramePlayerAdapter and useRadioStore; has VinylArt component with spin animation
- `frontend/lib/youtube-adapter.ts` — YouTube IFrame Player adapter (key playback file)
- `frontend/lib/radio-store.ts` — radio state store
- `frontend/lib/api.ts` — API helpers including `fetchRadioQueue`
- `frontend/components/radio/GhatAmbience.tsx` — Web Audio API ambience
- `frontend/components/radio/LiveClock.tsx` — orange theme applied
- `frontend/components/radio/ChhathFacts.tsx` — orange theme applied
- `frontend/components/radio/JalArghya.tsx` — orange theme applied
- `frontend/components/radio/UpNext.tsx` — orange theme applied
- `frontend/components/radio/ListenerCount.tsx` — orange theme applied
- `frontend/components/radio/GeometricBg.tsx` — orange theme applied
- `frontend/components/radio/NowPlaying.tsx` — orange theme applied
- `frontend/components/radio/Controls.tsx` — orange theme applied
- `docker-compose.yml` — orchestrates backend, frontend, postgres, redis
- `IMPLEMENTATION_PLAN.md` — project plan

## Current Status
All 10 reminders completed. Reading RadioPlayer.tsx to understand YouTube-based playback architecture. Lines 1-80 read; need to continue reading to understand full player implementation.

API endpoints confirmed:
- `/api/songs`, `/api/radio/queue`, `/api/channels/{slug}`, `/api/festival/current`, `/api/presence/heartbeat`, `/api/presence/listeners`, `/api/facts`, `/api/facts/random`, `/api/events`, `/api/admin/login`, `/api/admin/songs`, `/api/admin/songs/{song_id}`, `/api/chhath-dates`, `/health`

Queue data: 100 Chhath songs, each with `id`, `title`, `artist`, `category`, `sort_order`, `youtube_video_id`, `youtube_url`, `enabled`. Example: "Kelwa Ke Paat Par By Sharda Sinha", youtube_video_id: `-mpGoG0nWPo`.
